_note: Defaults for the pool. A repository's root pool-policy.json replaces this whole file; retained fields are required and no defaults merge in. Retired assessment, accrual and push fields are ignored and their old labels are left intact. The script writes only labels named by the retained policy.

severity.meaning: how bad this is if nothing is done, 4 the worst

urgency.meaning: how soon this needs attention, 4 the soonest

_tie_break: Implemented keys ordering equal rating proposals, most significant first. 'recent' reads updatedAt; the issue number is last. An empty list is lawful. Legacy 'symptoms' is ignored with a migration message; instances now extend pitches as comments.

framed.label: framed
framed.meaning: decided work: it is on the board rather than in the pool

cause.label: cause
cause.meaning: observed cause of the issues linked under it as sub-issues; not a task split into parts

_fade: An explicit fade closes an unframed open pitch after one full quiet window, regardless of ratings. Quiet is read from updatedAt and nothing stores a second clock. A dry run or closes=false writes nothing. The close keeps the issue's text and comments and records its reason; no command reopens it automatically.
